# Capstone 4: devkit, a Developer Toolkit

`devkit` is an all-in-one developer utility that consolidates cryptographic hashing, base64 encoding/decoding, JSON linting, and HTTP health checking under a single cohesive subcommand-driven binary.

## Dependencies

```toml
[package]
name = "devkit"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2024"

[dependencies]
clap = { version = "4.5", features = ["derive"] }
sha2 = "0.10"
base64 = "0.22"
serde_json = "1.0"
reqwest = { version = "0.12", features = ["blocking"] }
anyhow = "1.0"
```

## CLI Specification

```rust
use clap::{Parser, Subcommand};
use std::path::PathBuf;

#[derive(Parser)]
#[command(name = "devkit", about = "Swiss Army Knife Developer Utility")]
pub struct Cli {
    #[command(subcommand)]
    pub command: Commands,
}

#[derive(Subcommand)]
pub enum Commands {
    /// Compute SHA-256 cryptographic checksum of file or text
    Hash {
        #[arg(short, long)]
        text: Option<String>,
        #[arg(short, long)]
        file: Option<PathBuf>,
    },
    /// Base64 encode or decode data
    Base64 {
        #[arg(short, long)]
        decode: bool,
        input: String,
    },
    /// Format and validate JSON payload
    FormatJson {
        #[arg(default_value = "-")]
        input: String,
    },
    /// Query HTTP endpoint latency and response status
    Probe {
        url: String,
    },
}
```

## Modular Implementation

```rust
use anyhow::{bail, Context, Result};
use base64::prelude::*;
use sha2::{Digest, Sha256};
use std::fs;
use std::time::Instant;

pub fn handle_hash(text: Option<String>, file: Option<std::path::PathBuf>) -> Result<()> {
    let mut hasher = Sha256::new();
    if let Some(t) = text {
        hasher.update(t.as_bytes());
    } else if let Some(f) = file {
        let bytes = fs::read(&f).with_context(|| format!("Failed to read {:?}", f))?;
        hasher.update(&bytes);
    } else {
        bail!("Provide either --text or --file");
    }
    let result = hasher.finalize();
    println!("{:x}", result);
    Ok(())
}

pub fn handle_base64(decode: bool, input: &str) -> Result<()> {
    if decode {
        let bytes = BASE64_STANDARD.decode(input)?;
        let text = String::from_utf8_lossy(&bytes);
        println!("{text}");
    } else {
        let encoded = BASE64_STANDARD.encode(input);
        println!("{encoded}");
    }
    Ok(())
}

pub fn handle_probe(url: &str) -> Result<()> {
    let start = Instant::now();
    let res = reqwest::blocking::get(url)?;
    let elapsed = start.elapsed();

    println!("URL:      {}", url);
    println!("Status:   {}", res.status());
    println!("Latency:  {:.2?}", elapsed);
    Ok(())
}
```
